description: Probe-only rejection library for ASM_SDPA_ENGINE (backward) written for gfx942: a legal SDPA backward (bfloat16 or half, head size 128 or 192 for Q, K, V, O, dO, grouped-query off, BHSD or BSHD, no mask or causal, FP32 stats [B,H,Sq,1] as an INPUT, declared alignment 16) with ONE feature per case, named by the `family` axis; every family is a graph the frontend accepts (SdpaBwdNode::pre_validate_node). ARCH: SdpaBwdPlanBuilder.cpp isApplicable declines EVERYTHING on gfx950 at line 494 (device != gfx942), the only device available here, so on gfx950 every case declines at the device gate whatever the family; the `expect` values below are the engine's design on gfx942 and the attribute gates are only exercised there. This space is therefore written and checked in pytest only (shape draws, expansion, wiring), not run on a device. `expect` is `declined` where the engine must not take the graph (no kernel input for the feature or a truncated kernarg field, so an accept computes something else or faults) and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take it (a kernel row could be added). Lines cited are in SdpaBwdPlanBuilder.cpp. none: the control, a graph the engine takes on gfx942 (head size 128 or 192, mha, mask none / top-left / bottom-right causal, which the registry ships for both dtypes): declined_or_pass. odd_dims: batch, head count and sequence lengths not divisible by 4 at a shipped head size: the pssk = 1 padded kernels (computeDispatchTuples) serve any length and no check gates it: declined_or_pass. odd_head_size: head size not divisible by 4 and outside {64, 128, 192}: declined at 666, which a kernel could lift: declined_or_pass. dropout_philox: dropout_probability 0.1 with seed and offset tensors: declined at 506 (probability), 513, 514. dropout_p0: an explicit dropout_probability of 0 with no tensors is accepted (506 tests != 0): declined_or_pass. dropout_mask: cuDNN's explicit mask with dropout_scale and dropout_scale_inv: declined at 515. dropout_scale_inv_only [GAP]: dropout_scale_inv with no mask; no uid check exists for dropout_scale or dropout_scale_inv, and the CPU reference scales D = rowsum(dO * O) by dropout_scale_inv alone (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp backward, line 816), so an engine that takes the graph ignores the scale: expected declined, shows as a violation. alibi (510, with top-left causal band as the fwd probe), padding (padding_mask with seq_len_q / seq_len_kv, 511 and 536), seq_len_group (seq_len tensors without padding_mask select GROUP mode, 536), attn_mask (additive bias, 512), attn_mask_dbias (bias and its gradient output, 512 and 517): declined. scale_const: a compile-time-constant scalar Attn_scale tensor (pass-by-value, attn_scale_value unset) is accepted at 521-530: declined_or_pass. A device-resident scale tensor, which 527-530 declines, is not probed: the frontend rejects it (validateScalarParameter requires pass-by-value, SdpaBwdNode.hpp Rule 10b). stats_dt_io: stats in the io dtype: declined at 625 (must be FLOAT), a kernel could read it: declined_or_pass. stats_rank3: stats [B,H,Sq] rank 3: the strides at 282-283 are read from entries 0 and 1 only: declined_or_pass. stats_rank1 [GAP]: stats of rank 1: no rank guard on stats, so wouldBwdByteStridesFitUint32 reads strides entry 1 past the vector (282-283): expected declined, an out-of-bounds read shows as a violation or CRASH. dt_q_alt, dt_k_alt, dt_v_alt, dt_do_alt, dt_dq_alt, dt_dk_alt, dt_dv_alt: one of Q, K, V, dO, dQ, dK, dV in the other 16-bit dtype: the seven must share one dtype (637, tryGetDataTypeIdentifier): declined. dt_o_alt [GAP]: O in the other dtype; O is not in the 637 dtype check (only rank 4 and alignment), and the odo kernel reads it as the io dtype, so an accept computes D from a reinterpreted tensor: expected declined, shows as a violation. dt_all_float: all eight tensors float32: no kernel exists (637), one could be added: declined_or_pass. gqa: Hq = Hkv * group with group 2 or 4: declined at 618 (the kernel writes dK / dV by query head), a caller-side expansion could lift it: declined_or_pass. v_heads [GAP]: K has Hq heads but V (and dV) only 1; the frontend allows it (Rule 5 per tensor), 618 compares Q against K only and nothing reads V's head count, so the kernel indexes V by query head and writes dV past its buffer: expected declined, shows as a violation. asym_hd: head size 192 for Q and K, 128 for V and O: declined at 653, an MLA kernel could be added: declined_or_pass. hd64: head size 64: the registry has only pddv = 0 rows (comment at 658-665), lookups at 744-753 fail: declined_or_pass. window_hd192: sliding window (left bound 8 to 32, right bound 0 or 8) at head size 192: no mask-3 row at hd192 (744-753): declined_or_pass. overflow_stride, overflow_kernarg, overflow_dim: the `var` axis picks one kernarg field pushed past its limit at enforcement_level buildable (nothing is allocated, filled or executed). overflow_stride (var 0-7): q_batch, o_batch, dk_batch (batch stride 2**31 elements, B = 2; bf16 byte stride overflows uint32, 775-789 via wouldBwdByteStridesFitUint32, lines 264-266), k_head, do_head, dv_head (head stride 2**31), v_row, dq_row (row stride 2**31). overflow_kernarg (var 0-5): stats_batch, stats_head (fp32 LSE stride 2**30, 282-283), ts_hd128 (Ts = K row stride * 2 * ts with ts 192 from fmha_bwd_dqdkdv.csv, line 299; row stride 11184811, Skv 2), ts_hd192 (ts 64, row stride 33554432), dqacc_seq (dq_acc nhead stride Sq * D = 2**30 fp32, 288-292; Sq = 2**23, D = 128), dqacc_batch (Hq * Sq * D = 2**30 with Sq * D = 2**29: Sq = 2**22). overflow_dim (var 0-4): batch_dim (B = 2**32, dimFitsU32 at 595 / 223), heads_dim (Hq = Hkv = 2**32, 224-225), sq_dim, skv_dim (2**31, dimFitsI32, 226-227), hd_dim (head size 2**31, 228-229). Strides of the dim cases stay small. The row and head overflows push dependent larger strides over too. `expect` is declined: the kernarg field would truncate. An accepted and built overflow case is reported UNEXERCISED with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`, never PASS. Axes: family, `shape` (b, hkv, group, sq, skv, head size, layout, dtype), `band` (mask or window bounds), `var` (odd_dims / odd_head_size tuple and overflow field). Known gaps: dropout_scale_inv_only, stats_rank1, dt_o_alt, v_heads. Never frozen into a bundle.

derive.ovf: ['q_batch', 'k_head', 'v_row', 'o_batch', 'do_head', 'dq_row', 'dk_batch', 'dv_head'][var] if family == 'overflow_stride' else (['stats_batch', 'stats_head', 'ts_hd128', 'ts_hd192', 'dqacc_seq', 'dqacc_batch', 'stats_batch', 'stats_head'][var] if family == 'overflow_kernarg' else ['batch_dim', 'heads_dim', 'sq_dim', 'skv_dim', 'hd_dim', 'batch_dim', 'heads_dim', 'hd_dim'][var])
derive.mk: band[0] if family == 'none' and band[0] != 'window' else 'none'
derive.b_e: odd_b if family == 'odd_dims' else (1 if ts or (ov and ovf == 'stats_head') else (2 if ov else b))
derive.hkv_e: (1 if ts else 2) if ov else (odd_hkv if family == 'odd_dims' else (2 if family == 'v_heads' else hkv))
derive.sq_e: odd_sq if family == 'odd_dims' else ((64 if ts else (2**23 if ov and ovf == 'dqacc_seq' else (2**22 if ov and ovf == 'dqacc_batch' else 2))) if ov else sq)
derive.skv_e: odd_skv if family == 'odd_dims' else ((64 if ov and ovf in ['dqacc_seq', 'dqacc_batch'] else 2) if ov else skv)
derive.dqk_e: odd_d if family == 'odd_head_size' else (64 if family == 'hd64' else ((192 if ovf == 'ts_hd192' else 128) if ov else (192 if family in ['window_hd192', 'asym_hd'] else d)))
derive.b_d: 2**32 if ov and ovf == 'batch_dim' else b_e
derive.hq_d: 2**32 if ov and ovf == 'heads_dim' else hq
derive.hkv_d: 2**32 if ov and ovf == 'heads_dim' else hkv_e
derive.hv_d: 2**32 if ov and ovf == 'heads_dim' else hv
derive.sq_d: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'sq_dim' else sq_e
derive.skv_d: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'skv_dim' else skv_e
derive.dqk_d: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'hd_dim' else dqk_e
derive.dv_d: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'hd_dim' else dv_e
derive.k_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'k_row' else (11184811 if ov and ovf == 'ts_hd128' else (33554432 if ov and ovf == 'ts_hd192' else (hkv_e * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else dqk_e)))
derive.k_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'k_head' else (dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else skv_e * k_row)
derive.k_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'k_batch' else (skv_e * hkv_e * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else hkv_e * k_head)
derive.dt_k: alt if family == 'dt_k_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.o_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'o_row' else (hq * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else dv_e)
derive.o_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'o_head' else (dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else sq_e * o_row)
derive.o_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'o_batch' else (sq_e * hq * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else hq * o_head)
derive.dt_o: alt if family == 'dt_o_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.q_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'q_row' else (hq * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else dqk_e)
derive.q_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'q_head' else (dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else sq_e * q_row)
derive.q_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'q_batch' else (sq_e * hq * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else hq * q_head)
derive.dt_q: alt if family == 'dt_q_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.dk_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dk_row' else (hkv_e * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else dqk_e)
derive.dk_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dk_head' else (dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else skv_e * dk_row)
derive.dk_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dk_batch' else (skv_e * hkv_e * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else hkv_e * dk_head)
derive.dt_dk: alt if family == 'dt_dk_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.dq_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dq_row' else (hq * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else dqk_e)
derive.dq_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dq_head' else (dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else sq_e * dq_row)
derive.dq_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dq_batch' else (sq_e * hq * dqk_e if lay == 'bshd' else hq * dq_head)
derive.dt_dq: alt if family == 'dt_dq_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.dv_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dv_row' else (hv * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else dv_e)
derive.dv_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dv_head' else (dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else skv_e * dv_row)
derive.dv_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'dv_batch' else (skv_e * hv * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else hv * dv_head)
derive.dt_dv: alt if family == 'dt_dv_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.v_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'v_row' else (hv * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else dv_e)
derive.v_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'v_head' else (dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else skv_e * v_row)
derive.v_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'v_batch' else (skv_e * hv * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else hv * v_head)
derive.dt_v: alt if family == 'dt_v_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.do_row: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'do_row' else (hq * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else dv_e)
derive.do_head: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'do_head' else (dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else sq_e * do_row)
derive.do_batch: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'do_batch' else (sq_e * hq * dv_e if lay == 'bshd' else hq * do_head)
derive.dt_do: alt if family == 'dt_do_alt' else ('float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else dtype)
derive.dims_stats: [b_e * hq * sq_e] if family == 'stats_rank1' else ([b_d, hq_d, sq_d] if family == 'stats_rank3' else [b_d, hq_d, sq_d, 1])
derive.stride_stats: [1] if family == 'stats_rank1' else ([hq * sq_e, sq_e, 1] if family == 'stats_rank3' else ([2**30, sq_e, 1, 1] if ov and ovf == 'stats_batch' else ([hq * sq_e, 2**30, 1, 1] if ov and ovf == 'stats_head' else [hq * sq_e, sq_e, 1, 1])))
derive.right: 0 if family == 'alibi' or mk in ['causal_top_left', 'causal_bottom_right'] else (wr if family == 'window_hd192' else None)

constraints.rule: ov or b_e * hq * sq_e * skv_e * (dqk_e + dv_e) <= 2**29
constraints.reason: GPU reference cost ceiling (as SdpaBackward.space.json); the overflow family is built, never run
